name: ATX Transportation and Public Works
text:
The Formula 1 U.S. Grand Prix returns to Austin Oct. 22-25. 🏎️

🚐 Pre-paid shuttle service locations: Waterloo Park & Travis County Expo Center.

🚧 E. 10th St. & Red River St. will experience lane reductions & closures for shuttle services.
